title: Model variant contract implications and deployment readiness checklist
creator: Anika Shah
description: Objective: Build a repeatable playbook and a deployment readiness checklist that maps commercial contract terms (model licensing, redistribution, quantization allowances, PII handling clauses, and SLA penalties) to operational constraints for each model variant we offer to enterprise/private customers. Background: Sales and Solutions Engineering are regularly blocked during procurement when model licensing terms or third-party model restrictions prevent a recommended deployment pattern (e.g., on-prem weight residency vs. hosted inference fallback). The lack of a canonical mapping between contract clauses and runtime constraints leads to manual legal reviews that delay pilots and increase sales friction. Scope: - Analyze top 12 model variants in the catalog (open weights + partner-licensed) for license/restriction surface. - Create a matrix that translates contract language to runtime guardrails (allowed regions, whether weight export is permitted, quantization allowed, caching/eviction policies, tracing/PII collection limits). - Produce a deployment readiness checklist that Solutions Engineering and Sales Engineering can use to accelerate procurement and pilot signing. - Define pilot gating criteria and a pilot plan template tied to contract permissions. Out of scope: renegotiation strategy for third-party licenses (handled by Legal & Partnerships). Stakeholders: PM (Anika), Solutions Eng (Priya Reddy), Sales Engineering (Luca Moretti), Legal (Rhea Patel), Platform Ops (Denise Park), Runtime Eng (Carlos Ming). Deliverables: - Contract-to-runtime mapping matrix (canonical CSV/Confluence table) - Deployment readiness checklist (Confluence + PDF) - Pilot plan template for customers (3-tier: proof-of-concept, pilot, GA) - Recommended product guardrail implementation list (feature / config owners and priority) - Short briefing for Sales and Legal (slide deck)
acceptance_criteria: Canonical mapping created for top 12 model variants and reviewed by Legal
Deployment readiness checklist validated in two internal dry-run setups (VPC and on-prem sandbox)
Pilot plan template accepted by Solutions Eng and Sales (signature flows and success metrics defined)
Guardrail implementation list assigned to owners with rough estimates and priorities
Documentation published in Confluence and linked in the sales enablement playbook

decisions: Treat restrictive license clauses as blocking for weight export and model-variant substitution; runtime must implement a per-customer policy that prevents weight persistence or export when flagged.
Implement a conservative default: block advanced quantization for any model with explicit vendor restrictions; allow opt-in for permissive models only after Legal approves a model-variant profile.
Sales enablement will include two standard pilot packages (VPC-hosted with encrypted KV cache; on-prem with local-only KV and audit log retention controls) to reduce ad-hoc negotiations.
Create a small 'contract-playbook' addon for Solutions Eng that summarizes common clause language and the corresponding runtime checkbox to speed internal reviews.
